query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.name_ja, ds.sourceUrl, ds.source
FROM cards c
JOIN dataSources ds ON ds.cardId = c.id
WHERE (c.name LIKE '%Satoshi%' OR c.name_ja LIKE '%サトシ%' OR c.name LIKE '%SM-P 076%' OR c.name_ja LIKE '%SM-P 076%')
  AND ds.source = 'snkrdunk'
LIMIT 5;
